text:
josh: Quick sync: we need a firm rule for what adapter can forward into Private/Dedicated runtimes. goal: no accidental PII leak, but keep enough context for ops and debugging.
anika: We currently shove the whole `x-customer-meta` blob through. That includes tenant, env, feature flags, and sometimes a user-hash. Bad idea.
viktor: Proposal: split into header namespaces. `x-rw-trace`, `x-rw-route`, `x-rw-tenant` (only allowed under profile), `x-rw-meta` (kv pairs sanitized).
sara: For `x-rw-tenant` we should allow three encodings: `clear`, `hashed(v1)`, `sealed(kms-v1)`. Default to `hashed(v1)` for Hosted->Private.
josh: Important: sealed via control-plane KMS is ideal but adds CPU+latency. We need perf numbers before mandating.
anika: Also: who authorizes `clear` tenant? I suggest a capability bit on deployment: `telemetry:clear_tenant=true` and an admin grant flow; logged.
viktor: We need runtime fallback when control plane is unreachable. Fallback order: 1) local conservative policy (drop `x-rw-meta` keys matching /flag|env/), 2) hashed tenant, 3) reject forwarding.
sara: For sampling/traces: adapters must respect `x-rw-sample: 0|1` and honor `x-rw-sample-rate` up to a cap per deployment. Private customers can request lower caps in their manifest.
josh: Schema change idea: add `telemetry` block to manifest:
```
telemetry:
  profile: minimal|ops|debug
  clear_tenant_allowed: false
  sample_rate_cap: 0.1
```
default `minimal` = forward only trace+route (no tenant, no meta).
anika: `ops` profile forwards hashed tenant and whitelisted meta keys. `debug` forwards clear tenant + meta but is time-limited and audit-only.
viktor: Implementation note: adapters should call a tiny validation lib (control-plane published artifact) that returns a Decision { allow_keys:[], tenant_mode: hashed|sealed|clear, sample_allow: n }. Keep the lib stable (semver) and cache decisions for remote unavailability.
sara: Security: every time a manifest flips `clear_tenant_allowed` or profile -> `debug`, emit an immutable audit event with admin id + reason. Also require MFA for that change.
josh: Ops impact: Enable a short `debug_window` that auto-reverts after 60m. Also require an automated notification to oncall.
anika: Backwards compatibility: adapters that don't understand the new telemetry block should behave as `minimal`. We'll run a gradual rollout.
viktor: Testing: perf harness for KMS-seal path and seal+unseal latency under different payload sizes. I'll add tests.
sara: Action items: Viktor -> validation lib spec + caching TTL. Anika -> manifest schema PR + migration plan. Josh -> perf numbers for KMS and recommended default caps. I'll write audit + MFA requirements.
infra-bot: Created GH issue ARCH-telemetry-allowlist and added to milestone `next-rc`.
josh: Okay if no blockers we'll lock this for v-next. Any objections? :thumbsup:
anika: +1
viktor: +1
sara: +1
